description: This is a unit test class for the Secret class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.config.raw package. It contains tests for immutability, equals/hashCode, null argument handling, and getter/output correctness.

classes.name: SecretTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Secret class, verifying immutability, equality, null handling, and getter behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the Secret class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of the equals and hashCode methods of the Secret class.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullName
methods.description: Ensures that creating a Secret with a null name throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating a Secret with a null value throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the getName method returns the expected secret name.

methods.name: getValueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the getValue method returns the expected secret value.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Ensures that the toString method output contains the secret's name and value.
